FOPE 500.course_name: Sustainable Forest Management in a Changing World
FOPE 500.faculty: Faculty of Forestry and Environmental Stewardship
FOPE 500.description: Origins of sustainable forest management; criteria and indicators of sustainable forest management used globally and how these will need to be adapted to our changing climate. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

FOPE 501.course_name: Geomatics in Forestry: Data Collection and Management
FOPE 501.faculty: Faculty of Forestry and Environmental Stewardship
FOPE 501.description: Fundamental concepts of spatial technologies and geo-spatial analysis. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

FOPE 502.course_name: Introduction to Urban Forestry in the Asian Pacific Region
FOPE 502.faculty: Faculty of Forestry and Environmental Stewardship
FOPE 502.description: Principles behind urban forest governance, urban forest planning and green-space management, and their role in human health and wellbeing in the Asia-Pacific Region. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

FOPE 503.faculty: Faculty of Forestry and Environmental Stewardship
FOPE 503.description: Potential impacts of climate change on global forest systems. Concepts and techniques of climate change modelling; adaptive management strategies. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

FOPE 504.course_name: Structure and Composition of Tropical Forest Ecosystems
FOPE 504.faculty: Faculty of Forestry and Environmental Stewardship
FOPE 504.description: Ecological characteristics of tropical forests including their structure and composition. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

FOPE 505.faculty: Faculty of Forestry and Environmental Stewardship
FOPE 505.description: The ecological processes found in tropical humid and dry forests, including a series of case studies drawn from tropical forests around the world. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

FOPE 507.course_name: International Forestry Issues, Institutions, and Multilateral Agreements
FOPE 507.faculty: Faculty of Forestry and Environmental Stewardship
FOPE 507.description: Major contemporary global natural resources management issues emphasis on Forestry. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

FOPE 508.course_name: Forest Ecosystem Services and Community Livelihoods
FOPE 508.faculty: Faculty of Forestry and Environmental Stewardship
FOPE 508.description: Interdependence and dynamics of different forest ecosystem services and how they contribute to sustainable forest management and community livelihoods. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

FOPE 509.faculty: Faculty of Forestry and Environmental Stewardship
FOPE 509.description: Case studies of plantation forestry systems from around the world; advantages and challenges of intensively managed forests. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

FOPE 510.faculty: Faculty of Forestry and Environmental Stewardship
FOPE 510.description: Science of cultivating forest stands, including influence of climate and soil, characteristics of tree growth and stand development, and forest types and plantation designs. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

FOPE 511.faculty: Faculty of Forestry and Environmental Stewardship
FOPE 511.description: Manufacturing processes, applications and supply chains of solid wood, composite, and engineered wood products; pulp and paper, bio-based materials and bioenergy. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

FOPE 512.faculty: Faculty of Forestry and Environmental Stewardship
FOPE 512.description: General and forestry-specific economic principles and concepts, including role of forests in sustainable development. Prerequisite: All of FOPE_V 509, FOPE_V 510. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

FOPE 513.faculty: Faculty of Forestry and Environmental Stewardship
FOPE 513.description: Theoretical and technical skills to analyze corporate financial management in the forest industry, including analytical tools to analyze cost and benefit, evaluate risk, and identify optimum investment. Prerequisite: All of FOPE_V 509, FOPE_V 510. Corequisite: FOPE_V 512. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

FOPE 514.faculty: Faculty of Forestry and Environmental Stewardship
FOPE 514.description: Foundations of forest business enterprises (FBEs), including their role in forest management, interactions with stakeholders, and the drivers of successes and failures in FBEs. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.
